evals.prompt: 帮我创建一个文件系统工具，能列出指定目录下的文件和文件夹
evals.expected_output: A tool file at apps/runtime/src/tools/fs.ts with fsListDir tool definition (name: fs.listDir) and executor, plus registration in tools/index.ts

assertions.text: Tool name follows module.function format (lowercase module, camelCase function)
Definition uses 'satisfies LLMTool' type constraint
Executor signature is (params: Record<string, unknown>): string
Params are type-cast inside executor with 'params as { ... }'
Required params are listed in required array and exist in properties
Registration code includes toolHandler.register() call
Import includes LLMTool type from '../types/llm'
Variable name follows PascalCase module+Function concatenation
